title: PolicyShadowReport
description: NON-AUTHORITATIVE. What a selected policy baseline WOULD have said about the deterministic findings of one attempt. This packet is not evidence: it never changes a check status, never gates delivery, and never turns a FAIL into a PASS. Produced by the shadow evaluator (Block 2-P pilot); a model may propose a disposition but never decides one.

mode.description: Only 'shadow' exists today. A future enforcing mode must be a visible contract change, never a silent behavioural one.

authoritative.description: Always false. Present so that no consumer can render this packet as evidence by accident.

baseline_ref.description: The versioned baseline this evaluation used, or null when no baseline is selected. Absence is not an error: baselines are unavailable by default and everything is then UNCLASSIFIED.

version_hash.description: Content hash of the baseline directory, recomputed on load. A mismatch is refused, not warned about.

dispositions.description: One proposed disposition per deterministic finding evaluated. Proposals only.

rule_id.description: Scanner rule id, e.g. CKV_AWS_338. Absent when the finding carries none.

disposition.description: DEFECT: code should change. MISSING_DECISION: needs a parameter/choice the baseline does not supply — must never become LLM repair work. OUT_OF_SCOPE: control does not govern this workload class. UNSATISFIABLE: no code change can close it in this configuration (renamed from INAPPLICABLE in Block 4A, which read as a synonym of OUT_OF_SCOPE). UNCLASSIFIED: the baseline has no opinion — an expected and informative outcome, not a pilot failure.

reason.description: Why this disposition. For a baseline-driven proposal this cites the baseline entry; it is never free-form model narration presented as fact.

proposed_by.description: 'baseline' = deterministic lookup. 'model' = a skill proposed it and it carries no authority. 'default' = no baseline entry matched.

parameter.description: For MISSING_DECISION: the specific decision required, so intake can ask one focused question instead of guessing.

unclassified_count.description: Primary pilot output: how much of the scanner surface the first profile does not yet speak to.

error.description: Set when the evaluator itself failed. A broken pilot degrades to a recorded error and must never fail a mission.
